blocks.text: Access modifiers (pohanch tay karne wale tareeqe) woh keywords ya tareeqe hain jo tay karte hain ke class, us ke methods aur variables tak kaun pohanch sakta hai. Python mein yeh naam ke tareeqe (underscore) se tay hote hain:

items: Public: aise attributes aur methods jo class ke bahar se bhi istemal ho sakte hain (naam bina underscore).

blocks.text:
class Car:
    def __init__(self , color): self.color = color # Public property

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"class Car:": Car naam ki class banti hai. Class ek blueprint (naqsha) hai jis se objects bante hain.
"def __init__(self , color):": yeh constructor (object bante waqt khud chalne wala method) hai. self naya banne wala object hai aur color woh value jo object banate waqt di jati hai.
"self.color = color": di gayi value object ke andar color naam ki attribute (property) mein rakh di jati hai.
color ke naam ke shuru mein koi underscore nahi, is liye yeh public hai: class ke bahar se bhi car.color likh kar parhi ja sakti hai.
Output: kuch print nahi hota, kyun ke yahan sirf class define hui hai; na koi object bana na print hua. Maslan car = Car("red") aur print(car.color) likhein to red print hoga.

items: Protected: jo class ke andar aur us ki subclasses (us se bani classes) mein istemal hon (naam ek underscore se shuru, jaise _protected_var).

blocks.text:
class Car:
    def __init__(self): self._protected_var = 20 # Protected variable

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"class Car:": Car naam ki class banti hai.
"def __init__(self):": constructor jo object bante waqt khud chalta hai; yahan self ke ilawa koi parameter nahi.
"self._protected_var = 20": object mein _protected_var naam ki attribute banti hai jis ki value 20 hai.
Naam ke shuru mein ek underscore (_) ka matlab hai protected: yeh programmers ke liye ishara hai ke isay class aur us ki subclasses ke andar hi istemal karein. Python zabardasti nahi rokti.
Output: kuch print nahi hota, kyun ke sirf class define hui hai, koi object nahi bana aur koi print nahi.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Python protected ko zabardasti nahi rokti: _protected_var bahar se bhi parha ja sakta hai. Ek underscore sirf programmers ke liye ishara hai ke "isay bahar se na chhuein".

items: Private: jo class ke bahar se seedhe istemal na ho sakein. Private attribute ke naam ke shuru mein do underscores lagayein (__color).

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"class Car:": Car naam ki class banti hai.
"def __init__(self , color):": constructor jo object bante waqt color ki value leta hai.
"self.__color = color": naam ke shuru mein do underscores (__) hain, is liye yeh private attribute hai. Python is ka naam andar hi andar badal deti hai, is liye bahar se car.__color likhne par AttributeError aata hai.
"def get_color(self): return self.__color": yeh method class ke andar hai, is liye private value parh sakta hai aur usay wapas (return) kar deta hai. Bahar se color lene ka sahi raasta yahi method hai.
Output: kuch print nahi hota, kyun ke sirf class define hui hai. Maslan car = Car("blue") aur print(car.get_color()) likhein to blue print hoga.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab private wali misaal ko paragraph ke andar ek hi line mein chhapti hai (class Car: def __init__...), aur self.__color wali line margin par; aise SyntaxError aata hai. Sahi shakal oopar hai: har line alag aur theek indentation ke saath. (Wahan ek faltu number "2.8.1.3" bhi chhap gaya hai.)
__color private hai, yani class ke bahar se seedha nahi parha ja sakta (car.__color likhne par AttributeError aata hai). Is ke liye get_color() method istemal hota hai, jo value wapas deta hai.

Wazahat: pehli misaal mein Car class ka public attribute color hai jo seedha istemal hota hai. Private wali misaal mein __color sirf get_color() ke zariye milta hai: Car("red").get_color() se "red" aata hai.

blocks.prompt: Class ke bahar ka code private attribute kaise parh sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Class ke public method, jaise get_color(), ke zariye, seedhe nahi.

blocks.text: Is program mein brand public, _speed protected aur __color private hai. brand, speed aur color badal kar Run karein: public aur protected bahar se parhe jate hain, private sirf get_color() method se milta hai.

brand = "Suzuki"
speed = 60
color = "white"
class Car:
    def __init__(self, brand, speed, color):
        self.brand = brand      # public
        self._speed = speed     # protected (sirf ishara)
        self.__color = color    # private
    def get_color(self):
        return self.__color
car = Car(brand, speed, color)
print("Public brand:", car.brand)
print("Protected speed:", car._speed)
print("Private color (method se):", car.get_color())
try:
    print(car.__color)
except AttributeError:
    print("car.__color bahar se seedha nahi milta (AttributeError)")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"brand = "Suzuki"", "speed = 60", "color = "white"": teen variables jin ki values object banate waqt di jayengi.
"class Car:" aur "def __init__(self, brand, speed, color):": Car class aur us ka constructor (object bante waqt chalne wala method) jo teen values leta hai.
"self.brand = brand": public attribute (koi underscore nahi), bahar se seedhi parhi ja sakti hai.
"self._speed = speed": protected attribute (ek underscore); bahar se parhi ja sakti hai, magar yeh sirf ishara hai ke isay andar hi istemal karein.
"self.__color = color": private attribute (do underscores); bahar se seedhi nahi milti.
"def get_color(self): return self.__color": private color ko wapas dene wala method.
"car = Car(brand, speed, color)": Car ka ek object banta hai.
Teen print lines: car.brand, car._speed aur car.get_color() ki values dikhati hain.
"try:" ... "except AttributeError:": car.__color seedha parhne ki koshish AttributeError deti hai; except wala hissa us error ko pakar kar apna message print kar deta hai, is liye program crash nahi hota.
Output: "Public brand: Suzuki", "Protected speed: 60", "Private color (method se): white" aur aakhir mein "car.__color bahar se seedha nahi milta (AttributeError)".
Khud try karein: color = "black" kar ke Run karein: teesri line "Private color (method se): black" ho jayegi, magar aakhri line wahi rahegi.

items: Public: color; protected: _color (sirf ishara); private: __color (bahar se seedha nahi).
